description: GitHub Copilot CLI as a bare stateless engine node — `r4t engine copilot run`, one headless turn per wake with no roster or dispatcher; STATUS.md/LESSONS.md in the node's own root are its only memory. Every turn runs silent on a pinned binary and reports what it cost. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Tune it with --permissions and --max-credits on the invoke lines below; pin one conversation with --session <uuid> (never --continue, which resumes the machine's most recent session and has injected a prompt into a live one). `r4t engine copilot check` proves the argv still parses.
